description: Small power on a final circuit: the control room's workstations, displays and network gear behind an isolated or residual-current monitored circuit. It draws a steady base load with a slow, seeded swing (people at their desks, screens waking and sleeping).

trip.description: The equipment's own protection trips it off until reset.

name: Small power load

design_power.description: Full power of the equipment on the circuit.

power_factor.description: Power factor of the equipment's power supplies.

cycle.description: Spacing of the load's seeded swing.

min_fraction.description: Lowest share of full power the swing reaches.
